summary: SECA stakeholders request enhanced training, flexibility, and support for small vendors and complex procurements in the new E‑Rate bidding portal. No explicit policy claims identified. The comment proposes changes to the E‑Rate contract record system to improve accuracy and reduce processing time. SECA requests clearer, prospective documentation rules, snapshot data use, and review of public notice on part‑time student counting.
